a7q1.note: The Master of a Million Faces

resistPenalties.text: Your resistances are now 30% lower (Kitava's affliction). Check that your elemental resistances are still capped.
Your resistances are now 60% lower in total. Cap them before mapping.

notes.text: Sockets are white by default and accept any gem. Matching a gem's colour to a coloured socket gives a bonus. Any linked item is usable: don't skip links because of colours.
Mercenaries of Trarthus are in the core game. They are temporary and leave after some areas unless you play the Luminary (Scion) ascendancy.
5-link chance: clear the league encounter in this zone. In 3.27 and 3.29 it dropped a 5-link body armour once (not in 3.28). If nothing drops, re-running the zone can help.
Second 5-link chance: clear the league encounter in this zone (dropped a 5-link body armour once in 3.27 and 3.29).

Link plan: Tabula Rasa (6-link, level 3) as soon as you can trade; bench a 4-link after Kaom's Stronghold (Act 4, 5 fusings); the league encounters in The Slave Pens (Act 5) and Act 6 Twilight Strand have dropped a 5-link body armour; otherwise fuse a 5-6 socket armour (~150 fusings).
